Word a PR reply. The empty-input guard is fixed locally, its regression test passed, and it has not been pushed. Keep those facts and do not post it.

criteria.major-speed-win: React to the substantial main benefit with suitable enthusiasm, a relevant quoted callback, or a useful supported implication; do not merely praise partner coverage or invent experience.
criteria.quoted-joke: Warm encouragement or a short contextual callback; no explanation of the joke, invented completion or demand.
criteria.related-feature-question: Ask whether screen control also benefits; no assertion that it does.
criteria.known-comparison: A brief positive or playful comparison grounded in the supplied times/prices; no claim that the paid option itself is now free.
criteria.bad-news: Serious acknowledgment and recovery-status ask, preserving uncertainty without celebratory language.
criteria.issue-acknowledgment: Brief natural acknowledgment, no invented fix or follow-up obligation.
criteria.pr-status: All local/test/not-pushed facts survive with no delivery claim.
